meanings.meaning: 砸橱窗抢劫（指砸碎商店橱窗盗窃商品的行为）
meanings.usage: 复合名词，常用来描述针对商铺的快速抢劫行为
指有拱顶的通道，两侧通常开设商铺
不可数名词，统指各类珠宝首饰，美式英语常写作jewelry
后面可接名词或代词作宾语，常用搭配admire sb./sth.
可表示整理物品，也可表示安排活动、行程等
不可数名词，指质地柔软的丝绒面料
强调长时间目不转睛地看，常用搭配gaze at sth./sb.

meanings.meaning: （喇叭、音乐等）发出响亮而刺耳的声音
meanings.usage: 常用来描述噪音大的声响，主语多为horn、speaker等
可表示车辆高速行驶发出的轰鸣声，也可表示动物的咆哮
指用猛力将物体砸碎，常用搭配smash sth. with sth.
可指劫匪的抢劫行动，也可指警方的突击搜查
强调动作匆忙、慌乱，常用搭配scramble into/out of sth.
可形容速度、数量等非常惊人，也可表达对事物的夸赞

meanings.meaning: 烟灰缸（可数名词，由ash（烟灰）和tray（托盘）复合构成）

meanings.usage: 指人物或动物的雕塑作品

phrases.usage: 表示车辆、机器等逐渐停下，强调停止的过程，比stop更具画面感

examples.en: The bus came to a stop just in time to avoid hitting the child.
examples.zh: 公交车及时停了下来，避免撞到那个孩子。

examples.en: The engine sputtered and finally came to a stop.
examples.zh: 引擎噼啪响了几声，最终停了下来。

phrases.usage: 指擅自取用、偷窃，也可礼貌邀请别人随意取用食物、物品等

examples.en: The intruder helped himself to all the cash in the safe.
examples.zh: 闯入者偷走了保险箱里所有的现金。

examples.en: Please help yourself to some drinks if you are thirsty.
examples.zh: 如果你渴了请随便喝点饮料。

phrases.usage: 形容速度极快，相当于at an extremely high speed

examples.en: The sports car drove past at a fantastic speed.
examples.zh: 跑车以极快的速度开了过去。

examples.en: The project is progressing at a fantastic speed.
examples.zh: 这个项目正以惊人的速度推进。

phrases.usage: 表示偷了某物后成功逃脱，也可表示做了坏事却没有受到惩罚

examples.en: The burglars got away with jewellery worth over £100,000.
examples.zh: 窃贼偷走了价值10万多英镑的珠宝，逃之夭夭。

examples.en: Don't think you can get away with lying to me.
examples.zh: 别以为你对我撒谎能蒙混过关。

phrases.usage: with的独立主格结构，用来描述伴随状态，结构为with + 宾语 + 宾补（形容词/副词/介词短语等）

examples.en: He stood in the rain, with his clothes completely wet.
examples.zh: 他站在雨里，衣服全湿了。

examples.en: She left the office, with the lights still on.
examples.zh: 她离开了办公室，灯还亮着。

phrases.usage: 表示“价值……的东西”，结构为“金额/时间 + worth of + 名词”

examples.en: The storm caused thousands of pounds worth of damage.
examples.zh: 风暴造成了价值数千英镑的损失。

examples.en: I bought two weeks' worth of food before the holiday.
examples.zh: 放假前我买了够吃两周的食物。

phrases.usage: 表示留在驾驶座上开车，wheel此处指代汽车的方向盘

examples.en: You stay at the wheel while I go into the shop to buy some water.
examples.zh: 我去商店买水的时候你留在车里开车。

examples.en: He stayed at the wheel for 6 hours before stopping to rest.
examples.zh: 他连续开了6小时车才停下来休息。

grammar.title: 过去完成进行时
grammar.structure: had been + 动词现在分词（doing）
grammar.definition: 表示过去某个时间之前一直持续进行的动作，强调动作的持续性和连贯性，动作可能刚结束，也可能还在进行 常和since+时间点、for+时间段等时间状语连用，描述在过去某个动作发生前已经持续了一段时间的动作

examples.en: Two of his assistants had been working busily since 8 o'clock and had only just finished.
examples.zh: 他的两个助手从8点就一直在忙，刚刚才做完。

examples.en: I had been waiting for the bus for half an hour when it finally arrived.
examples.zh: 我已经等了半小时公交车，它才终于来。

examples.en: He had been studying English for three years before he went abroad.
examples.zh: 他出国前已经学了三年英语。

grammar.title: while引导的时间状语从句（过去进行时搭配）
grammar.structure: While + 从句（过去进行时）, 主句（过去进行时/一般过去时）
grammar.definition: while表示“当……的时候”，引导时间状语从句时，通常强调主从句的动作在过去同一时间段同时发生 从句的动作通常是延续性的，主从句动作同时发生时，延续性动作用过去进行时，短暂性动作用一般过去时

examples.en: While this was going on, Mr. Taylor was upstairs.
examples.zh: 当这一切发生的时候，泰勒先生在楼上。

examples.en: While I was cooking dinner, my husband was watching TV.
examples.zh: 我做晚饭的时候，我丈夫在看电视。

examples.en: While we were walking in the park, it began to rain.
examples.zh: 我们在公园散步的时候，开始下雨了。

patterns.pattern: The silence was suddenly broken when + 事件

original.en: The silence was suddenly broken when a large car, with its headlights on and its horn blaring, roared down the arcade.
original.zh: 宁静突然被打破，一辆大轿车亮着前灯，响着喇叭，呼啸着冲进了拱廊街。

imitations.en: The silence was suddenly broken when a fire alarm went off in the building.
imitations.zh: 大楼里的火警突然响起，打破了宁静。

imitations.en: The silence was suddenly broken when a child started crying loudly in the library.
imitations.zh: 一个孩子在图书馆里大声哭了起来，宁静突然被打破。

patterns.pattern: Just as + 某事正在发生, 主语 + 动作

original.en: Just as it was leaving, Mr.Taylor rushed out and ran after it throwing ashtrays and vases.
original.zh: 就在轿车离开的时候，泰勒先生冲了出来，跟在后面追赶，一边扔烟灰缸和花瓶。

imitations.en: Just as the train was leaving, she arrived at the station out of breath.
imitations.zh: 就在火车要开的时候，她气喘吁吁地赶到了车站。

imitations.en: Just as I was taking a photo of the sunset, my phone died.
imitations.zh: 就在我要拍日落的时候，我的手机没电了。

original.en: The raid was all over in three minutes, for the men scrambled back into the car and it moved off at a fantastic speed.
original.zh: 抢劫行动总共只用了3分钟，因为那些人争先恐后地爬回车里，然后以极快的速度开走了。

imitations.en: We decided to cancel the picnic, for the weather forecast said it would rain heavily.
imitations.zh: 我们决定取消野餐，因为天气预报说会下大雨。

imitations.en: He didn't attend the meeting, for he had caught a bad cold the day before.
imitations.zh: 他没有参加会议，因为前一天他得了重感冒。

lines.en: The expensive shops in a famous near Piccadilly were just "opening.
lines.zh: 皮卡迪利大街附近的一条著名拱廊街道上，几家高档商店刚刚开始营业。

lines.en: At this time of the morning, the arcade was almost empty.
lines.zh: 在早晨的这个时候，拱廊街上几乎空无一人。

lines.en: Mr.. Taylor, the owner of a jewellery shop was admiring a new display.
lines.zh: 珠宝店主泰勒先生正在欣赏新布置的橱窗。

lines.en: Two of his assistants had been working busily since eight o'clock and had only just finished.
lines.zh: 他手下两名店员从早上8点就开始忙碌，这时刚刚布置完毕。

lines.en: Diamond necklaces and rings had been beautifully arranged on a background of black velvet .
lines.zh: 钻石项链、戒指漂亮地陈列在黑色丝绒上面。

lines.en: After gazing at the display for several minutes, Mr.. Taylor went back into his shop.
lines.zh: 泰勒先生站在橱窗外凝神欣赏了几分钟就回到了店里。

lines.en: The silence was suddenly broken when a large car, with its headlights on and its horn blaring, roared down the arcade.
lines.zh: 宁静突然被打破，一辆大轿车亮着前灯，响着喇叭，呼啸着冲进了拱廊街，在珠宝店门口停了下来。

lines.en: It came to a stop outside the jeweller's.
lines.zh: 一人留在驾驶座上，另外两个用黑色长筒丝袜蒙面的人跳下车来。

lines.en: One man stayed at the wheel while two others with black stocking over their faces jumped out and smashed the window of the shop with iron bars.
lines.zh: 他们用铁棒把商店橱窗的玻璃砸碎。

lines.en: While this was going on, Mr.. Taylor was upstairs.
lines.zh: 这开始发生时，泰勒先生正在楼上。

lines.en: He and his staff began throwing furniture out of the window.
lines.zh: 他与店员动手向窗外投掷家具，椅子，桌子飞落花流水在拱廊街上。

lines.en: Chairs and tables went flying into the arcade.
lines.zh: 一个窃贼被一尊很重的雕像击中，但由于他忙着抢钻石首饰，竟连疼痛都顾不上了。

lines.en: One of the thieves was struck by a heavy statue, but he was too busy helping himself to diamonds to notice any pain.
lines.zh: 这场抢劫只持续了3分钟，因为窃贼争先恐后地爬上轿车，以惊人的速度开跑了。

lines.en: The raid was all over in three minutes, for the men scrambled back into the car and it moved off at a fantastic speed.
lines.zh: 就在轿车离开的时候，泰勒先生从店里冲了出来，跟在车后追赶，一边还往车上扔烟灰缸、花瓶。

lines.en: Just as it was leaving, Mr.. Taylor rushed out and ran after it throwing ashtrays and vases, but it was impossible to stop the thieves.
lines.zh: 但他已无法抓住那些窃贼了。

lines.en: They had got away with thousands of pounds worth of diamonds.
lines.zh: 他们已带着价值数千镑的首饰逃之夭夭了。

questions.q: How did Mr. Taylor try to stop the thieves?
questions.zh: 泰勒先生试图怎样阻止窃贼？
questions.a: He and his staff began throwing furniture out of the window, and chairs and tables went flying into the arcade. Just as the car was leaving, he rushed out and ran after it, throwing ashtrays and vases, but it was impossible to stop the thieves.
questions.aZh: 他和店员向窗外投掷家具，椅子和桌子飞落到拱廊街上。就在轿车离开时，他冲出去追车，一边扔烟灰缸和花瓶，但无法拦住窃贼。
questions.hint: 答案见课文 He and his staff began throwing furniture... 及 Just as it was leaving, Mr. Taylor rushed out... 两句

questions.q: What had the two assistants done before the robbery?
questions.zh: 抢劫发生前，两名店员做了什么？
questions.a: They had been working busily since eight o'clock, arranging the new display; diamond necklaces and rings had been beautifully arranged on a background of black velvet, and they had only just finished.
questions.aZh: 他们从早上八点起一直忙着布置新橱窗，把钻石项链和戒指漂亮地陈列在黑色丝绒衬底上，刚刚才布置完毕。
questions.hint: 课文第4—5句（had been working busily since eight o'clock / had been beautifully arranged）

questions.q: How did the thieves smash the shop window?
questions.zh: 窃贼是怎样砸碎商店橱窗的？
questions.a: One man stayed at the wheel while two others, with black stockings over their faces, jumped out and smashed the window of the shop with iron bars.
questions.aZh: 一人留在驾驶座上，另外两个用黑色长筒丝袜蒙面的人跳下车，用铁棒砸碎了商店的橱窗玻璃。
questions.hint: 课文第9句（smashed the window of the shop with iron bars）

questions.q: How long did the raid last, and what happened to one of the thieves?
questions.zh: 这场抢劫持续了多久？其中一名窃贼遇到了什么？
questions.a: The raid was all over in three minutes. One of the thieves was struck by a heavy statue, but he was too busy helping himself to diamonds to notice any pain.
questions.aZh: 抢劫只持续了三分钟。一名窃贼被一尊很重的雕像击中，但他只顾着抢钻石，根本顾不上疼痛。
questions.hint: 课文第12—13句（all over in three minutes / struck by a heavy statue / too busy helping himself to diamonds）

questions.q: Why was it impossible to stop the thieves, and what does the speed of the raid suggest?
questions.zh: 为什么泰勒先生无法拦住窃贼？抢劫的迅速又说明什么？
questions.a: Because the car had already moved off at a fantastic speed and the thieves had got away with thousands of pounds worth of diamonds. The whole raid was over in three minutes, which suggests the crime was carefully planned and carried out quickly and precisely.
questions.aZh: 因为轿车早已以惊人的速度开走，窃贼带着价值数千镑的钻石逃走了；整个抢劫只用了三分钟，这说明犯罪经过精心策划，行动迅速而精准。
questions.hint: 结合课文最后两句及 The raid was all over in three minutes 推断

translation:
皮卡迪利大街附近的一条著名拱廊街道上，几家高档商店刚刚开始营业。
在早晨的这个时候，拱廊街上几乎空无一人。
珠宝店主泰勒先生正在欣赏新布置的橱窗。
他手下两名店员从早上8点就开始忙碌，这时刚刚布置完毕。
钻石项链、戒指漂亮地陈列在黑色丝绒上面。
泰勒先生站在橱窗外凝神欣赏了几分钟就回到了店里。
宁静突然被打破，一辆大轿车亮着前灯，响着喇叭，呼啸着冲进了拱廊街，在珠宝店门口停了下来。
一人留在驾驶座上，另外两个用黑色长筒丝袜蒙面的人跳下车来。
他们用铁棒把商店橱窗的玻璃砸碎。
这开始发生时，泰勒先生正在楼上。
他与店员动手向窗外投掷家具，椅子，桌子飞落花流水在拱廊街上。
一个窃贼被一尊很重的雕像击中，但由于他忙着抢钻石首饰，竟连疼痛都顾不上了。
这场抢劫只持续了3分钟，因为窃贼争先恐后地爬上轿车，以惊人的速度开跑了。
就在轿车离开的时候，泰勒先生从店里冲了出来，跟在车后追赶，一边还往车上扔烟灰缸、花瓶。
但他已无法抓住那些窃贼了。
他们已带着价值数千镑的首饰逃之夭夭了。
title: Smash and Grab
subtitle: 砸橱窗抢劫

lead.question: 皮卡迪利附近珠宝店遭光天化日抢劫，泰勒先生如何尽力阻止窃贼，结果又如何？
lead.warmup: 伦敦拱廊街的清晨几近无人，一家珠宝店的橱窗里刚摆好钻石项链和戒指。突然，一辆亮着车灯、响着喇叭的大轿车呼啸而来，一场精心策划的抢劫在三分钟内上演。店主泰勒先生和店员奋力反击：从楼上扔下家具，又追着汽车投掷烟灰缸和花瓶。读完本课，你将读懂这起“砸橱窗抢劫”的全过程，并学会用过去完成进行时描述背景。
goals: 掌握 smash、grab、jeweller、arcade、assistant 等与抢劫、商店相关的核心词汇
理解并运用过去完成进行时（had been doing）描述抢劫前店员一直忙碌的场景
学会用过去完成时被动语态（had been arranged）描写橱窗的布置
能复述这起“砸橱窗抢劫”的经过，并分析窃贼作案迅速、计划周密的特点
lead.summary: 课文讲述皮卡迪利附近拱廊街珠宝店遭抢劫的故事。清晨街上几乎无人，店主泰勒先生正欣赏店员从八点起一直忙着布置、陈列在黑色丝绒上的钻石首饰。突然一辆轿车鸣笛冲入，两名蒙面人用铁棒砸碎橱窗行抢。泰勒先生与店员扔下家具反击，仍未能阻止窃贼；抢劫仅三分钟，他们便带着数千镑钻石逃走。
lead.tips: 注意区分过去完成进行时与一般过去时：“两名店员从八点起一直在忙”用 had been working，强调此前持续的动作；而“抢劫在三分钟内发生”用一般过去时 was。另外，蒙面用的长筒丝袜要写复数 stockings。

exercises.q: 汉译英：他们用铁棒砸碎商店橱窗，抢走了钻石项链和戒指。
exercises.a: They smashed the window of the shop with iron bars and grabbed the diamond necklaces and rings.

exercises.q: 汉译英：珠宝店主泰勒先生的两名店员从早上八点起一直忙碌着。
exercises.a: The two assistants of Mr. Taylor, the owner of a jewellery shop, had been working busily since eight o'clock.
exercises.note: since 后接时间点，用 had been doing。

exercises.q: 句型转换：把下面句子改为被动语态（保持过去完成时）。She had arranged diamond necklaces and rings beautifully on a background of black velvet.
exercises.a: Diamond necklaces and rings had been beautifully arranged on a background of black velvet.
exercises.note: arrange = lay out，此处用被动语态。

exercises.q: 填空：The expensive shops in a famous ______ near ______ were just opening, and the ______ was almost empty.（提示：拱廊街 / 皮卡迪利）
exercises.note: arcade 拱廊街；Piccadilly 皮卡迪利。

exercises.q: 改错：One man stayed at the wheel while two others with black stocking over their faces jumped out and smashed the window.
exercises.a: 把 stocking 改为 stockings（with black stockings over their faces）。
exercises.note: 表示两只长筒袜，应用复数 stockings。

exercises.q: 填空：He was too busy helping himself ______ diamonds ______ notice any pain.
exercises.note: help oneself to 擅自取用。

exercises.q: 汉译英：令我们吃惊的是，他们带着价值数千镑的钻石逃走了。
exercises.a: To our surprise, they had got away with thousands of pounds worth of diamonds.
exercises.note: to one's surprise 令某人吃惊的是。

quiz.q: 泰勒先生是哪家商店的店主？
quiz.note: the owner of a jewellery shop。

quiz.q: 窃贼是用什么砸碎橱窗的？
quiz.note: smashed the window with iron bars。

quiz.q: 抢劫发生前，珠宝店的橱窗里是什么样子？
options: The window was still completely empty.
Diamond necklaces and rings had been arranged on black velvet.
Only a few cheap rings were on display.
The assistants had not started their work yet.
quiz.note: 钻石首饰陈列在黑色丝绒上。

quiz.q: 两名窃贼用什么蒙住了脸？
quiz.note: with black stockings over their faces。

quiz.q: 这场抢劫持续了多长时间？
quiz.note: The raid was all over in three minutes。

quiz.q: 泰勒先生和店员为了阻止窃贼做了什么？
options: They handed over the diamonds at once.
They locked themselves in the shop.
They called the police on the phone.
They threw furniture out of the window and later ashtrays and vases.
quiz.note: 先扔家具，追车时扔烟灰缸、花瓶。
